title: Show warning when server save fails
description: If saving to the server fails (server error, network issue, or payload too large), the app now shows 'remote save failed' instead of 'saved', so you know the server copy may be out of date. Your local browser backup is unaffected.

title: Smoother sync: silent auto-merge + auto-update
description: Sync conflicts that can be resolved automatically by timestamp are now applied silently without interrupting you. The app also updates itself automatically when a new version is available.

title: Fix deleted items reappearing after sync
description: Deleting a page, flowchart node, sticky note, page type, or stat on one device no longer causes it to reappear when syncing with another device.

title: Fix share view ignoring per-page section visibility overrides
description: Sections marked visible via the per-page override toggle (not the schema default) now correctly appear in the player share view, including all their subheaders.

title: What's New only shows entries you haven't seen
description: The What's New popup now filters to only show changelog entries added since you last dismissed it, instead of always showing the same top entries.

title: Fix flowchart connections not syncing correctly
description: Deleting a connection on one device no longer causes it to reappear when syncing with another device.

title: Theme changes now sync across devices
description: Changing the theme on one device now syncs to your other devices. Previously, theme was treated as a local-only preference and never propagated.

title: Insert links in rich-text editors
description: A link button (and Ctrl+K shortcut) in the rich-text toolbar lets you wrap selected text in a hyperlink or insert a new link.

title: Fix emoji picker not showing emojis
description: Emoji picker now uses native system emoji instead of loading images from an external CDN, which was failing in production.

title: Fix share view showing blank pages
description: Player-facing share links now correctly display page content. A schema migration had broken the share endpoint, causing all shared pages to appear empty.

title: New Bubblegum theme
description: Added a soft pink Bubblegum theme inspired by the classic Winamp skin.

title: New nodes appear at center of visible canvas
description: Adding a node or sticky note now places it at the center of your current view instead of a fixed position on the canvas.

title: Sticky notes: drag handle to move notes
description: Sticky notes now have a drag handle at the top so they can be moved around the flowchart.

title: Flowchart split: page on left, flowchart on right
description: In the flowchart split view, the page editor now appears on the left and the flowchart on the right.

title: Fix migration error for campaigns with invalid page types
description: Campaigns with pages that had the raw type string "mission" instead of a proper page type ID (a data integrity issue from older schema versions) now load and migrate cleanly instead of showing a migration error on startup.

title: Flowchart + editor split view
description: Enable a split layout from the Flow tab that shows the flowchart on the left and a page editor on the right. Click 'Open page' on any node or double-click it to open the page instantly in the editor pane.

title: Add free-floating notes to flowcharts
description: You can now add sticky-note text boxes to flowcharts via the 'Add note' button. Notes are draggable, editable inline, and support color-coding from the side panel.

title: Flowchart nodes move live while dragging
description: Dragging a flowchart node now shows its new position in real time instead of snapping into place only after you release the mouse.

title: Installable offline PWA
description: The app can now be installed on your device like a native app and works offline. Edits are saved locally and synced to the server when you reconnect — which automatically triggers conflict detection if another device edited in the meantime.

title: Sync conflict detection and resolution
description: When the same campaign is edited on two devices, the app now detects the conflict on load (or when you resume editing after an hour of inactivity) and lets you choose between the server version, your local version, or an auto-merged result that combines non-overlapping edits from both.

title: Straighten corkboard section boxes
description: Corkboard theme sections no longer have subtle random rotations applied, so the boxes appear straight.

title: Flowchart and page tree stay in sync on delete
description: Deleting a node in the flowchart now also removes its linked page. Deleting a page (or page tree) from the sidebar now also removes any associated flowchart nodes and edges.

title: Double-click flowchart node to open page
description: Double-clicking a node in the flowchart view now opens that node's page directly in the editor.

title: What's New popup & changelog
description: Added a changelog popup that shows new features on first visit, with per-entry priority, startup preference in Settings, and a full scrollable changelog view.

title: Drag-and-drop page reordering
description: Pages in the sidebar can now be dragged to reorder or reparent them into a different parent.

title: Unified dev server startup
description: Running npm run dev now starts both the frontend and backend together via a Vite API proxy — no more two separate terminals.

title: Unified activity bar & mobile nav
description: Desktop sidebar and mobile bottom bar are now a single NavBar component, giving a consistent look across screen sizes.

title: VS Code-style activity bar with icons
description: Navigation moved to a left-side activity bar with Lucide icons on desktop; previous text-only tabs removed.
